title: OpenAI supports California’s bill to advance youth AI safety
summary: OpenAI supports California SB 1119, advancing strong, age-appropriate AI safeguards for teens while preserving opportunities to learn, create, and explore.
body: OpenAI supports California SB 1119, advancing strong, age-appropriate AI safeguards for teens while preserving opportunities to learn, create, and explore.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布支持加利福尼亚州的SB 1119法案。该法案旨在为青少年提供适龄的AI安全保障，同时在监管框架下保留青少年学习、创作和探索AI技术的机会，体现了企业在AI伦理与合规方面的积极参与。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI公开支持加州青少年AI安全法案，反映了行业头部企业在AI监管与合规方面的立场变化。
